decisions.reason: As a core email sending service prominently featured on the home page, it closely matches existing messaging knowledge, making early results easy to interpret and improve through in-house R&D.
Although document recognition is less central than messaging, the firm's document workflow expertise and R&D allow it to learn from early results, so the drop probability is moderate.
This product directly combines existing email and fax capabilities, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and apply its messaging expertise to improve it.
Because it is a feature close to the established fax offer, the firm already possesses the relevant knowledge to interpret results and enhance the product quickly.
